user.title: Price source
user.description: Pick the sensor that provides the prices. It must have a `prices` attribute with `start`, `end`, `buy` and `sell` for each interval (per kWh), like the *Upcoming prices* sensor of the OPCOM PZU integration. Prices must already include what you pay and receive (taxes, VAT, commission).

data_description.price_entity: Needs a `prices` attribute; see the documentation for the format.

battery.title: Battery
battery.description:
Used to plan when buying cheap and selling dear pays off, using your buy and sell prices.

A kWh sold must have been bought for less than: *sell price − degradation cost*, multiplied by the efficiency.

**Your real battery (optional):** pick a state-of-charge sensor (%, Wh or kWh) so today's plan starts from what is actually stored, and optionally a capacity sensor (Wh or kWh) to replace the fixed capacity below. Without them the plan assumes an empty battery.

data.battery_usable_pct: Share of the battery to use

data_description.battery_charge_power_kw: Most power the battery can draw from the grid, in kW at the grid side. 300 W = 0.3 kW.
data_description.battery_discharge_power_kw: Most power it can deliver to the grid, in kW. 1200 W = 1.2 kW. Charging and discharging limits are often different.
data_description.battery_round_trip_efficiency_pct: Share of grid energy that comes back out: buy → store → sell. 85-95% is typical for lithium batteries.
data_description.battery_degradation_per_kwh: Battery wear per kWh delivered, in {currency}. Roughly battery price per kWh ÷ lifetime cycles (e.g. 1500 ÷ 6000 = 0.25).
data_description.battery_soc_entity: Percent, Wh or kWh. Used for today's plan.
data_description.battery_capacity_entity: Usable capacity in Wh or kWh. Replaces the fixed capacity.
data_description.battery_usable_pct: The planner only works with this share of the capacity. The rest is a reserve at the bottom that is never sold (backup power, your own use). 50% of a 10 kWh battery means 5 kWh to plan with and 5 kWh kept.

error.no_prices: That sensor has no usable `prices` attribute. Pick a sensor that follows the price series format.

general.description: How far ahead the *Time to cheapest price* and *Time to best sell price* sensors look.

data_description.timer_horizon_hours: Hours from now, 1 to 48. If tomorrow's prices are not published yet, only what is known is searched.
